description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) UNLEASH THE LIONS (Lions of the Emperor, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the fixture's own Command phase). No window ('Your Command phase'): the player real-clicks the S button, UNLEASH THE LIONS's Use button and the Allarus Custodians (TERMINATOR, 3 models) in the unit picker (1 CP): the unit splits into three one-model units that stay where they were.

steps.comment: REAL click: open the S (stratagem) panel
REAL click on the panel's Use button
REAL click on the friendly unit
the Game Log names the stratagem
